## Quick announcement: LaTeX Workshop! 

::: nonincremental

Interested in learning about how to use **LaTeX**? Grayson White and Marcus Robinson will host a workshop for getting started with TeX **today, Thursday, September 3rd from 6:00 pm - 6:30 pm in Eliot 314**. 

- The workshop will utilize Overleaf. They will focus on getting a first document set-up and then spend some time learning basic commands. 

- Anyone is welcome but this workshop is specifically targeted for new LaTeX users!

- While LaTeX is not required for this course, it can be really helpful for formatting equations in your assignment files! 

:::

## Lab logistics

- Labs are due at the end of the lab period as **PDFs** on **Gradescope**
- If we run out of time to try all problems...
    - Just submit the progress you made
    - It will be helpful to finish at your own pace after class, but you don't need to submit again
    - Solutions (+ sometimes feedback) will be shared via Gradescope
- If you have an error preventing your PDF from rendering, shoot me an email, submit by the end of the day
- We'll work on labs in small groups and periodically discuss progress all together
